assets.basis: Public Oyostepper product download; SolidWorks 2014 STEP AP214, file timestamp 2018-03-06. Distributor reference, not a claim that current production is identical.
Dimension drawing linked by the StepperOnline Canadian product page.

drawingComparison: 57 mm CAD body is inside the StepperOnline drawing's 57.3 mm maximum envelope.
47.14 mm pitch, 21 mm shaft, 38.1 mm pilot, 1.6 mm pilot height and shaft flat agree with the StepperOnline drawing.
5.1 mm CAD mounting bores are inside the drawing's 5.2 +/- 0.25 mm tolerance. The generator follows the pinned CAD's 5.1 mm bore.
The separate older Oyostepper PDF specifies 47 +/- 0.1 mm and different casing screw positions; it is not used to override the audited STEP or the StepperOnline mounting drawing.
omittedFromGenerator: Casing screws and their internal bores
qualification: Nominal mechanical reference and installation clearances only; production tolerances, torque/preload and cable routing are not qualified. Electrical ratings are unchanged.
